title.narrative: Strengthening professional capacities of Senior Civil Servants in Serbia

description.narrative: The intervention aims to support implementation of the National Public Administration Reform (PAR) Strategy. In particular, it targets strengthening managerial and professional capacities of senior civil servants through implementation of targeted modern development and training programme. The Action is expected to result in increased capacity of senior civil servants for strategic and financial management, public policy making, coordination, planning and monitoring.
